privileged_info_for_vlm: The module name must be exactly 'Space_Weather'. The required satellites are SUOMI NPP (37849), NOAA 19 (33591), METOP-C (43689), and GOES 16 (41866). Note that in Gpredict's internal logic, 'All views (narrow)' corresponds to layout index 6 (though the agent will select it by name in the GUI). The ground track length must be set to 3 orbits.
